rubrics.justification: No image was available, yet the response introduced hypothetical embryo grades and features (e.g., 4AA-5AA, tight ICM, organized TE), which are fabricated rather than image-based.
It integrates most relevant patient factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, male factor, and cycle history, and connects them to prognosis, though some links are speculative.
The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to stated assumptions, though the morphology-dependent scenarios rest on unsupported assumptions.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice, including SET in a young patient, luteal support, and consideration of male-factor workup; minor deviations include speculative benefit claims and somewhat casual PGT-A suggestion at age 30.

Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, lifestyle changes, luteal support, and future male-factor evaluation, though some advice is generic.
